module: CMU (driving dynamics management center, Driving Dynamics Suite): controller that orchestrates the sub-controllers of the `drivingDynamics/` folder (`sensors/` sensors, `supervisors/` supervisors, `actuators/` actuators). It finds and registers them (`registerCMU`), exposes accessors (getSensor, getSupervisor, getActuator...), detects rollover and crash, manages the global system state (normal, degraded, offline), the blinking warning light, calibration callbacks, and a UDP debug channel (by default 127.0.0.1:54812) for an external tool. Call order: `defaultOrder = 50`.
usage:
local cmu = controller.getControllerSafe("drivingDynamics/CMU")
local hub = cmu.getSensor("sensorHub")
for _, a in ipairs(cmu.getActuators()) do print(a.name) end
notes: Bug: `indicateUI = jbeamData.indicateUI == nil and true or false` gives true only if the key is absent; if the jbeam explicitly sets `indicateUI` to true, the value becomes false.
`enableDebugHeartbeat` is always true (`true or not shippingBuild`): the UDP "BNGDSE" heartbeat is sent at 1 Hz and the received commands are read, if the UDP socket connected.

Recognized UDP commands (format `type->controllerName[->json]`): RequestConfig, EnableDebugMode, SetConfig, SetProperty. EnableDebugMode does not check that the recipient exists (error if unknown name).

Electrics written: `dseCrashStopped`, `dseRollOverStopped`, `dseRollingOver` (1 or nil), `dseWarningPulse` (warning light; fixed 1 if the system is not normal), `isYCBrakeActive` and `isTCBrakeActive` (0 at init). Reads `postCrashBrakeTriggered`.
The light blinks at 0.15 s when the `yawControl` or `tractionControl` supervisor is acting (`isActing`).
initLastStage: if a sub-controller does not have `isActive`, all systems are shut down (`shutdown`) and the state goes to offline.
No supervisor or sensor is defined in this batch; only the actuators and sensorHub of the batch are documented.

The fields updateCalibrationCallback, updateFixedStepCalibrationCallback and updateGFXCalibrationCallback are `nop` (empty function) as long as no callback is registered; sensorHub, vehicleData and virtualSensors are nil until initSecondStage.

warningLightPulse.desc: 0 or 1, toggles every 0.15 s for the warning light blinking.

updateCalibrationCallback.desc: nop or function that runs the update-type calibration callbacks.

updateFixedStepCalibrationCallback.desc: nop or function that runs the updateFixedStep-type callbacks.

updateGFXCalibrationCallback.desc: nop or function that runs the updateGFX-type callbacks.

applyParameter.desc: Modifies a parameter of a configuration table identified by a dotted path (e.g. "uiDisplayData.simplePowertrainApp.activeColor"). The value "default" restores the initial value. Never creates a new parameter.

changedParameters.desc: Table of changes, keyed by dotted path.

returns.desc: true if a parameter was modified.

disableSystemsForCalibration.desc: Disables all supervisors (`setParameters({isEnabled = false})`) to allow a calibration.

getActuator.desc: Finds an actuator by its file name in `drivingDynamics/actuators/`.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the CMU configuration.

returns.desc: Deep copy of the control parameters.

getSensor.desc: Finds a sensor by its file name in `drivingDynamics/sensors/`.

getSupervisor.desc: Finds a supervisor by its file name in `drivingDynamics/supervisors/` (e.g. yawControl, tractionControl).

init.desc: Opens the debug UDP socket, prepares the control parameters (UI display) and clears the crash electrics.

initLastStage.desc: Checks that all sub-controllers are active (otherwise shuts them down), puts the state back to normal and sends an init debug packet.

initSecondStage.desc: Lists the sub-controllers of the drivingDynamics/ folder, registers them with the CMU (`registerCMU`), finds the base sensors and disables debug mode.

logDebugMessage.desc: Adds a debug message (`systemDebugMessage` packet) to the queue sent over UDP.

registerCalibrationCallback.desc: Registers a function called at each step (update, updateFixedStep or updateGFX) during a calibration.

reset.desc: Clears the debug packets, the crash electrics and the smoothers, and puts the state back to normal.

sendDebugPacket.desc: Adds a packet to the debug queue (writing `vehicleID` into it).

setDebugMode.desc: Enables or disables the CMU's debug mode (choice of the updateGFX variant) and propagates it to all sub-controllers having `setDebugMode`, then rebuilds the caches.

debugEnabled.desc: true to send the debug data at 30 Hz.

setParameters.desc: Modifies the CMU's display parameters (uiDisplayData.simplePowertrainApp.activeColor, offColor, doUpdate) and `notifySystemStateDegraded`; updates the "DSE" button of the driveModes controller if present.

systemDegradationDetected.desc: Puts the system in degraded state, logs the reason in the debug and marks the damage `systemStateDegraded`.

systemDegradationResolved.desc: Puts the system back to normal state and clears the damage `systemStateDegraded`.

update.desc: Physics step: runs the update-type calibration callbacks.

updateFixedStep.desc: Fixed step (100 Hz): runs the updateFixedStep-type calibration callbacks.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: detects rollover and crash, animates the warning light, runs the GFX calibration callbacks and (depending on debug mode) exchanges the UDP packets. Replaced by a debug variant via setDebugMode.
